**ORDER** Whereas, M/s DHFL General Insurance Limited (M/s DHFLGIL) was granted Registration by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (the Authority) to conduct general insurance business in India vide IRDAI Registration No 

18. Whereas M/s DHFLGIL has applied to the Authority through General Insurance Council seeking exemption from complying with limits of expenses of management stipulated under Section 40B of the Insurance Act, 1938 read with I ROAi (Expenses of Management of Insurers transacting General or Health Insurance business) 

> Whereas the Executive Committee of the General Insurance Council has 

DHFLGIL. Now therefore, the Authority, after careful consideration of the application of M/s DHFLGIL and the recommendations of the General Insurance Council, in exercise of powers vested in it under Regulation 11 of the IRDAI (Expenses of Management of Insurers transacting General or Health Insurance Business) Regulations, 2016, hereby grants exemption to M/s DHFLGIL from complying with the limits of expenses of management stipulated under Section 40B of Insurance Act, 1938 read with IRDAI (Expenses of Management of Insurers transacting General or Health Insurance business) Regulations, 2016. The said exemption shall be valid for Financial Years
